topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: When you open a new brokerage account, you may be asked to specify your overall investment goals (or "objectives") and how much risk you are willing to tolerate.
question: When opening a brokerage account, why might you be asked about your investment objectives and risk tolerance?
answer: The broker may ask so you can identify your overall investment goals and how much risk you are comfortable taking. Understand what the firm’s objective or risk categories mean, and consider when you may need quick access to the funds. Ask your broker if you have questions.
